# File secrets use unlinked read-only descriptors; dotenv values use their
# declared names. Neither selector is revealed into the worktree.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin

cp raw-fixture raw.txt
cp env-fixture vars.env
exec sesam add raw.txt vars.env
rm raw.txt vars.env

env INHERITED=kept
exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt --env-file vars.env -- runprobe env INHERITED RAW TOKEN EMPTY LITERAL SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT
stdout 'INHERITED="kept" exists=true'
stdout 'RAW="/dev/fd/3" exists=true'
stdout 'SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT="" exists=false'
stdout 'TOKEN="dotenv value" exists=true'
stdout 'EMPTY="" exists=true'
stdout 'LITERAL="\$\(touch_owned\)" exists=true'
! exists raw.txt
! exists vars.env
! exists touch_owned

exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe files RAW
stdout 'RAW="raw-value\\n" mode=0400 links=0'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

# Binary file contents and non-UTF-8 dotenv values survive delivery unchanged.
exec runprobe write-binary binary.dat
exec runprobe write-binary-env binary.env
exec sesam add binary.dat binary.env
rm binary.dat binary.env
exec sesam run --secret BLOB=binary.dat -- runprobe files BLOB
stdout 'BLOB="a\\x00\\xffb\\n" mode=0400 links=0'
exec sesam run --env-file binary.env -- runprobe env BINARY
stdout 'BINARY="a\\xffb" exists=true'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe args 'hello world' ';touch-owned' '$HOME'
stdout '0="hello world"'
stdout '1=";touch-owned"'
stdout '2="\$HOME"'
! exists touch-owned

# Dotenv-only invocations do not need file descriptors for secrets.
exec sesam run --env-file vars.env -- runprobe env TOKEN SESAM_SECRET_VARS_ENV
stdout 'TOKEN="dotenv value" exists=true'
stdout 'SESAM_SECRET_VARS_ENV="" exists=false'

# The repository lock is released before starting the supervised command.
exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe reenter
stdout '^admin$'

# Cwd-relative selectors become canonical sesam-relative paths before repo use.
mkdir sub
cp raw-fixture sub/nested.txt
exec sesam add sub/nested.txt
rm sub/nested.txt
cd sub
exec sesam run --secret NESTED=./nested.txt --secret ROOT=../raw.txt -- runprobe files NESTED ROOT
stdout 'NESTED="raw-value\\n" mode=0400 links=0'
stdout 'ROOT="raw-value\\n" mode=0400 links=0'
! exists nested.txt

# From outside the repository selectors are sesam-relative.
cd ../..
exec sesam --sesam-dir $WORK run --secret NESTED=sub/nested.txt -- runprobe files NESTED
stdout 'NESTED="raw-value\\n" mode=0400 links=0'

-- raw-fixture --
raw-value
-- env-fixture --
# strict dotenv fixture
export TOKEN = 'dotenv value'
EMPTY=
LITERAL=$(touch_owned)
